note: The owner's voice-note grades of the lines he judged in batches 13 to 20 that the first voice-note file (voice-notes-batches-11-19.json) does not already grade, plus the lines he judged in the Oct 27 and Oct 28 playtest sittings. Read from docs/coordination/voice-notes/2026-10-15-words-orders-part-1.md (sections 9 and 16), 2026-10-15-words-orders-part-2.md (sections 19, 21, 23, 27, 31, 35, 36), 2026-10-23-words-lead.md and 2026-10-24-playtest.md, plus the quotes in docs/coordination/playtest/2026-10-27-1-log.md and 2026-10-28-1.md (points 11, 37 and 38). Scale: he liked it ("I like that", "that's good", "solid", "great", "perfect") is good; he rejected the sentence itself ("weird", "awkward", "doesn't make sense", "unnatural", "dev talky") is bad; "the sentence is fine but the context is wrong" ("doesn't fit here", his number three), neutral ("sure", "that's fine") and lines that match no current part get no row. Each row is one part, so a line said in two banks is two rows. Quotes are speech-to-text and matched to the parts tolerantly.
